title: Wear : TT used for bolus calc
body:
@olorinmaia You have a minor bug in the new wear tiles.

On my phone, when using calculator, _use TT_ is not checked.

![Screenshot_20251222_123038_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e913577-9bee-47bb-a28f-e56794f9deb0)

But, when I used the tiles and calc button on watch, TT was used in the calculations. I couldn't see if/where it could be turned OFF on watch.

![Screenshot_20251222_122702_androidaps.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/47893cb1-a3e9-4baa-90de-b68c6e520bbf)

![Screenshot_20251222_123125_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2619f784-e8ff-45f5-b4c9-be922697bc66)

Using latest dev

![Screenshot_20251220_093508_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8747a2dd-afab-4b89-9b9c-466bc9375796)

comments.body: Hi @robertrub. Check Wear plugin settings. This controls if TT should be accounted for or not in Wear. If you disable it you won't see (TT: xx) if a TT is active.

Ok, I found them but they are VERY hidden/not easy to find :(

Wouldn't it be better/more logical if watch calculator used the same settings as phone calculator ?

They are well hidden, agree on that. I also think it should be possible to "save" the default calculations to be used on phone. But that would probably be another issue (feature request). 

The phone app doesn't really store your preferred calculations in a good way right now.
I suppose that the phone keeps the calculator settings somewhere... The calculator remembers the settings used "last time".

> I suppose that the phone keeps the calculator settings somewhere... The calculator remembers the settings used "last time".

True, but it won't allow you to always calculate for TT, or everything off. So it definitely could be improved. I'm not sure it should share preferences with wear calculator though. I would close this issue and open another one with what you think should be improved in AAPS settings :)
